verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the MIT-licensed Community Edition can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure with full data ownership, managed through a self-host admin dashboard, with an Enterprise self-hosted edition also offered. A community report independently confirms it can be self-hosted. Caveats from the community: the desktop app cannot log in to self-hosted instances, a self-hosted magic-link email bug was reported, and some features (e.g., SAML SSO, audit logs) are reserved for the Enterprise edition. Missing for 10: concrete deployment/installation documentation (e.g., container or infra steps) in evidence, desktop-app login to self-hosted instances, and hands-on corroboration that self-hosted auth works reliably.
